evals.prompt: For a responsive React analytics dashboard, search local UI/UX references, propose a design system and list checks for the actual screen.
evals.expected_output: Evidence-backed design guidance with interface verification separated from recommendation.
expectations: Uses actual local corpus and provenance.
Does not claim WCAG conformance without product/AT evidence.

evals.prompt: Audit a web UI against current Vercel guidelines; network may be unavailable and each finding needs file:line.
evals.expected_output: Current-source audit with exact locations, or blocked/not_run where retrieval is unavailable.
expectations: Checks current guidelines when network works.
Does not reuse stale cached text as current.

evals.prompt: Create an original one-page poster and export a PNG; this is not an application UI.
evals.expected_output: Route to nested Canvas Design; use an actual renderer or report unavailable.
expectations: Does not rely on placeholder canvas functions as renderer.
Does not claim PNG without render and file verification.
